acceptance_repairs.given: The current repository and the five existing governed packages; declarations may be incomplete and no validation result is assumed.
acceptance_repairs.when: Verify current formal paths and stage snapshot file hashes against an independent restored copy, and verify the supported external durable-copy receipt binds that same current snapshot payload before final completion.
acceptance_repairs.then: Formal inputs/code/plan/evidence remain in the original repository; a current selected snapshot is independently restorable and has a real authorized durable copy outside the ephemeral environment. Missing, incomplete or mismatched external persistence blocks this obligation.

oracle.observable: Verify current formal paths and stage snapshot file hashes against an independent restored copy, and verify the supported external durable-copy receipt binds that same current snapshot payload before final completion.
oracle.expected: Formal inputs/code/plan/evidence remain in the original repository; a current selected snapshot is independently restorable and has a real authorized durable copy outside the ephemeral environment. Missing, incomplete or mismatched external persistence blocks this obligation.
forbidden: A local snapshot alone is claimed to provide external durability
A baseline-only remote snapshot is claimed to cover newly changed bytes
A remote receipt or historical execution fact is fabricated
Missing external persistence is counted as success merely because it is disclosed
